origin: Exact pinned public Git repo checkouts and locally executed deterministic MOTIF source-map rules

focus.next_human_gate: Review one exact source cut, host/resource owner's informed permission, recipient authority and one source-backed synthetic cross-project test before presenting an integration as executable.

selected_unproven_edge.claim: A proposed planZ record does not automatically provide PlayDeck rendered full-performance evidence.

questions.question: Which exact source-owner contract should be inspected before a map edge is called a working integration?
questions.smallest_falsifiable_probe: Choose one declared edge, retrieve its owner's cited source and test what it actually asserts.
questions.why: Public branch inventory is far broader than human-curated source-linked relations.

questions.question: Which owner will choose one exact public source cut for a negative-control integration test?
questions.smallest_falsifiable_probe: Pin just one source and define both pass and HOLD outcomes before any cross-repository action.
questions.why: The plan owner lists source pinning, donor compatibility, capability permission and independent verification as missing gates.

questions.question: Can a proposed planZ plan actually satisfy the original PlayDeck performance-receipt contract?
questions.smallest_falsifiable_probe: A proposed-only plan must HOLD; only a truly witnessed typed performance receipt could satisfy a separately reviewed positive test.
questions.why: CANNON records this exact crossing as unverified; GRAFT can inspect the donor's original source without running it.

selected_next_test.first_step: Use owner-original public source files to construct an independently runnable planZ-to-PlayDeck typed negative fixture.
selected_next_test.name: ONE_SOURCE_PINNED_ADAPTER_NEGATIVE_CONTROL
selected_next_test.possible_positive: Only independent source-owner-reviewed witnessed receipt may justify a positive adapter test.
selected_next_test.required_refusal: PROPOSED_UNVERIFIED plan must NOT be interpreted as a completed performance receipt.
selected_next_test.why: A missing typed receipt is an inspectable claim, unlike asserting thousands of branches automatically compose.
